full_judgment: 2. The facts, relevant for disposal of the instant civil petition for leave to appeal are that the respondent Nos. 1-10 as plaintiffs filed title Suit No. 1 of 1998 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Char Fashion, Bhola, for declaration of title in the suit land with further declaration that the order dated 30.12.1997 passed in Miscellaneous Case No. 92/95-96 described in schedule `Kha' to the is plaint illegal, collusive and not binding upon the plaintiffs. They stated inter alia that the suit land measuring 00810 `shahashranqsha' of Mouja Char Toffazzel, C.S. Khatian No. 4205/6 was khas land of the Government and the father of the plaintiffs, namely Abdul Mannan took settlement of the said land from the Government on payment of salami and has been possessing the same by running business thereon and that after the death of the plaintiff's father they inherited the said land but having failed to take steps, the khatian could not be prepared in their names. Subsequently, they filed an application in the office of the defendant No.  3 for a new khatian in the name of the plaintiffs, and accordingly a Miscellaneous Case No. 92/95-96 was started. Defendant No. 3 asked defendants No. 1 to inquire into the matter and submit a report, but defendant Nos. 4 and 5 in collusion with defendant Nos. 1 and 2 managed to submit a false report .While defendant Nos. 4 and 5 tried to grab the property, defendant No. 3 by his order dated 30.12.1997 started 4 proceeding of a miscellaneous case to grant re-settlement. The said order is illegal, without jurisdiction and not binding upon the plaintiffs and that defendant Nos.  4and 5 demolished their shop room on 03.10.2002 and forcibly erected two small houses on 28.10.2002, and hence the suit. By a subsequent amendment of the plaint they added a prayer for evicting defendant Nos. 4 and 5 upon demolishing the two huts erected by them on the suit land.
